title: Controls in Rust: one action map for keys, pads and touch controls, rebinding and prompts
note: Name actions once in game.input, read ctx.actions, add game.touch_controls for phones and controls_panel(ui) to rebind; prompts are display text.
intent: Controls are actions, never keys. Register one ActionMap with game.input: a Context::new(id, priority) per mode, each action a .button, .axis1 or .axis2 with every way to reach it (keys, Binding::Pad by position, Binding::Stick, Binding::Touch(control)), conditions counted in ticks with .when (Condition::Press, Hold, Tap, Cooldown). Escape and the pad's home button are reserved (input-binding-reserved). On phones add game.touch_controls(TouchControls::new().stick(..).button(..).show(ShowWhen::Touch)); drawn or not they read the same, and a desktop click is touch 0. Read ctx.actions.fired, .axis2 or .down in on_update. A pause menu disables the play context and enables the built-in UI context, so menus move by ui_* actions; controls_panel(ui) there rebinds and saves genex-input.json. Show a prompt with glyph_ui(ui, &ctx.actions.glyph(action)) and never keep its label in the world. A replay is (seed, bindings digest, TickInput rows); a demo taps a touch control with Input::touch_start/touch_end at its centre. Read state().__input (refusal, unknownReads) when an action never fires.
port: One facet owns game.input and game.touch_controls (each registers once); another facet adds its actions as a context of that map and reads ctx.actions for its own actions only.

evidence.note: The map, contexts, bindings, conditions and modifiers, ctx.actions, the ui context, prompts as display text, touch controls, controls_panel and genex-input.json, the replay promise and the refusals.
Menu::new(..).item(..).back(..).show(ui) answers the picked key and moves by the ui_* actions while game.input is registered.
Input: name actions once with game.input and read ctx.actions.
